**REGISTERED POST WITH ACKNOWLEDGEMENT DUE**

To,  
[Tenant's Full Name]  
[Tenant's Complete Address]  

**SUBJECT: LEGAL NOTICE FOR RECOVERY OF ARREARS OF RENT AMOUNTING TO RS. 50,000/-**

Under the instructions from and on behalf of my client, [Landlord's Full Name], residing at [Landlord's Address], I hereby serve you with this Legal Notice and call upon you to note that pursuant to the lease agreement dated [Date of Agreement, if applicable] in respect of the premises situated at [Complete Property Address], you are in default of paying the agreed monthly rent of Rs. [Monthly Amount] for the period from [Start Month/Year] to [End Month/Year], accumulating to a total outstanding arrears of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only); you are therefore hereby called upon to pay the said sum of Rs. 50,000/- to my client within a period of 15 (fifteen) days from the receipt of this notice, failing which my client shall be constrained to initiate appropriate civil and criminal legal proceedings against you for recovery of the rent, eviction, and interest at your sole cost and risk, reserving all rights to pursue further remedies.

[City]  
[Date]  

**[Advocate Name]**  
Advocate, [Bar Council / City]
